routes.description: Requires a signed-in account with the admin role.

200.description: The proposals that wait for a person and the decisions already taken. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

404.description: The server has no such route. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

502.description: The node watchdog refused or could not answer the request. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

503.description: The channel to the node watchdog is not configured or does not answer (available false). The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

routes.description: Requires a signed-in account with the admin role. The body is the incidentId, the decision (approved or rejected) and, to approve, confirm: true; the account that decides is the signed-in one, named by the server.

200.description: The watchdog took the decision; the answer carries it. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

400.description: Invalid request (approving needs confirm: true). The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

404.description: The server has no such route, or the proposal is not pending any more. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

502.description: The node watchdog refused or could not answer the request. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

503.description: The channel to the node watchdog is not configured or does not answer (available false). The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.
